name: SkyNile Airways
prompt: You are a customer service agent for SkyNile Airways.
answer: Answer in one to three sentences, using only the given context.
fallback: I'm not sure about that, so I'll pass your question to a colleague.

questions.q: How much carry-on can I bring with Economy Lite?
questions.reference: One carry-on bag up to 7 kg, and no checked bag.

questions.q: Can I get a refund on an Economy Lite ticket?
questions.reference: No, Lite tickets can't be changed or refunded.

questions.q: What does it cost to change an Economy Classic ticket?
questions.reference: $50 plus any difference in fare.

questions.q: If I cancel a $400 Economy Classic ticket, how much do I get back?
questions.reference: $300 (refund minus the $100 fee).

questions.q: how much for an extra bag on a 2 hour flight
questions.reference: $60, since the flight is under 3 hours.

questions.q: I'm flying Economy Classic and my bag weighs 28 kg. Is there a fee?
questions.reference: Yes, $50 extra for a bag between 23 and 32 kg in Economy.

questions.q: Can I check a 35 kg suitcase?
questions.reference: No, bags over 32 kg are not accepted.

questions.q: When does online check-in open?
questions.reference: 24 hours before departure.

questions.q: When does online check-in close for an international flight?
questions.reference: 90 minutes before departure.

questions.q: The adult fare is $500. What does my 1-year-old on my lap pay?
questions.reference: $50 (10% of the adult fare).

questions.q: The adult fare is $500. How much is it for my 9-year-old?
questions.reference: $375 (75% of the adult fare).

questions.q: My 12-year-old is flying alone, there and back. What does the service cost?
questions.reference: $160 ($80 per flight, two flights).

questions.q: Can my 5 kg cat fly with me in the cabin?
questions.reference: Yes, if the cat and its carrier weigh 8 kg or less together, for $75 per flight.

questions.q: Can I take my dog on a flight to London?
questions.reference: No, pets aren't allowed on flights to the United Kingdom.

questions.q: Do I have to pay for a wheelchair at the airport?
questions.reference: No, it's free; request it at least 48 hours before the flight.

questions.q: I booked yesterday for a flight next month. Can I still cancel for free?
questions.reference: Yes, bookings made 7+ days before departure can be cancelled free within 24 hours of booking.

questions.q: My flight is delayed by 4 hours. What do I get?
questions.reference: A meal voucher.

questions.q: My flight is 6 hours late, can I get my money back?
questions.reference: Yes, with a delay over 5 hours you can get a full refund or rebook for free.

questions.q: How many miles do I earn on a $600 Economy Flex ticket?
questions.reference: 1,200 miles (2 per dollar).

questions.q: What do I get with Silver status?
questions.reference: One extra checked bag on every flight; it takes 25,000 miles in a year.

questions.q: How much is it to pick a seat on Economy Lite?
questions.reference: $15 for a standard seat.

questions.q: How much is an exit row seat?
questions.reference: $35 on all Economy fares.

questions.q: Does a Business ticket include the lounge?
questions.reference: Yes.

questions.q: Can I bring my golf bag? How is it charged?
questions.reference: Yes, sports equipment counts as a checked bag.
